evidence.title: Complete serialized inventory
evidence.scope: Metadata counts and category estimates. No authored or visible coverage is inferred.

evidence.title: Original authored surface provenance
evidence.scope: Three original albedo identities have explicitly mapped authored replacement sources. Other art studies remain unmapped.

evidence.title: Stone and timber UV review
evidence.scope: Blender albedo review on the original Rock_3_Untitled and pole meshes, with retained UVs and material transforms. No native game shader claim.

evidence.title: 67-degree roof atlas UV review
evidence.scope: Three isolated original roof submeshes use the fitted atlas. Companion faces, assembled roofs and native shaders are outside this UV review.

evidence.title: Native replacement texture sampling
evidence.scope: The exact granite_hd_albedo, timber_hd_albedo and roof_atlas_hd_albedo replacements passed native texture sampling. No mesh streaming claim.

evidence.title: Three material replacements in game menu fixtures
evidence.scope: Standing stone, pole and complete 67-degree roof fixtures used production-bound authored albedos. The roof companion cutout remains original. No final art or world approval.

evidence.title: Exact original roof fixture identity
evidence.scope: Explicit serialized mesh ID, renderer hierarchy, topology and slot order establish the retained roof geometry used by the menu fixture.

evidence.title: Default roof alpha and UV preparation
evidence.scope: Original alpha and whole-image UV layout inspection only. Standard and corner fringe replacements still need authored fitting.

evidence.title: Authored standard straw-fringe candidate
evidence.scope: 512 RGBA candidate for straw_roof_alpha only. Mask derived from original project art; no copied game pixels or masks. UV, compressed mips, native shader and game checks pending. The smallest mips lose cutout coverage.

evidence.title: Staged cutout adapter native checks
evidence.scope: 35 checks passed with an owned diagnostic shader, including stored-float and keyword state checks, asynchronous ownership and complete drain. The installed game is unchanged. This does not validate the new fringe texture, original game shader or mesh streaming.
